subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can predict a story from its title and pictures and scan for details.
I can describe the characters with adjectives, comparatives and superlatives.
I can find the main ideas of a story and give my opinion.

tf.s: In The Baking Day, the red bowl is the biggest.
tf.why: Yes! The red bowl is the biggest.

tf.s: The blue bowl is bigger than the red bowl.
tf.why: The blue bowl is smaller than the red bowl.

tf.s: Arwa is more confident than Areej.
tf.why: Right! Arwa is the more confident girl.

tf.s: The recipe was for eighty people.
tf.why: The recipe was for eight people, but they baked a cake for eighty.

tf.s: Milk and bananas are foods in the recipe.
tf.why: The recipe foods are eggs, sugar, butter and flour.

tf.s: In The Tennis Lesson, the boys are playing tennis.
tf.why: Yes! The story is about a tennis lesson.

tf.s: Hamed is the best at tennis in the class.
At the start of the story, Hisham is good at tennis.
tf.why: At the start, he is good at painting and doing experiments.

tf.s: One main idea of The Tennis Lesson is: friends help each other.
tf.why: Great! Friends help each other, and practice helps us get better.

tf.s: Hisham's ball always hits the net because the net is broken.
tf.why: He isn't good at hitting the ball with his racquet yet.

boxes.q: Which is a food in the recipe?
boxes.why: The recipe has eggs, sugar, butter and flour.

boxes.q: What sport are the boys playing?
boxes.why: The story is The Tennis Lesson.

boxes.q: Who is the best at tennis in the class?
boxes.why: Hamed is the best at tennis.

boxes.q: What do you hit the ball with in tennis?
boxes.why: We hit the ball with a racquet.

hunt.q: Hisham is good at ___ at the start.
You hold it to hit the ball

mcq.q: Which foods are in the Baking Day recipe?
mcq.why: Milk and bananas are not in the recipe.

mcq.q: What is Hisham good at at the start of The Tennis Lesson?
mcq.why: He is good at painting and experiments, not tennis yet.

mcq.q: What are the names of the two graded readers?
o: The Baking Day and The Tennis Lesson
Stop, thief! and The Space Race
My Granny and My family's unusual
mcq.why: These are Graded readers 1 and 2 for Unit 1.

mcq.q: Which story words are from The Tennis Lesson?
Retell The Baking Day with a superlative. Which sentence is correct?
o: The red bowl is the biggest.
The red bowl is the bigger.
The red bowl is biggest than the blue bowl.
The red bowl is the most big.

mcq.q: Sort the adjectives: shy, kind, polite, hard-working. Which is correct?
o: Hisham: shy, hard-working. Hamed: kind, polite.
Hisham: kind, polite. Hamed: shy, hard-working.
Hisham: shy, polite. Hamed: kind, hard-working.
mcq.why: Hisham is shy and hard-working; Hamed is kind and polite.

mcq.q: What could the girls change to make a better cake?
o: Read the recipe carefully and make a smaller cake.
Use a smaller bowl for eighty people.
mcq.why: Reading the recipe carefully stops the counting mistake.

mcq.q: Why does Hisham's ball always hit the net?
o: He isn't good at hitting the ball with his racquet yet.
mcq.why: He needs practice to hit the ball well.

mcq.q: What are the two main ideas of The Tennis Lesson?
o: Friends help each other; with help and practice you can become good at something.
Tennis is easy; nobody needs help.
Painting is better than tennis; Hamed is rude.
Cakes are big; recipes are hard.
mcq.why: Friends help each other, and practice helps us get better.
